summary: Conversation search no longer re-reads every page of every remote conversation at each index refresh. It probes each remote conversation's newest entry and reads its newest 200-entry page only when that entry changed or the indexed page is an hour old. Refreshes log their trigger, remote source count, remote reads and elapsed time.

schema.detail: No persistent schema changes; the search index is in memory.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Search covers only the newest 200 entries of a remote conversation; such conversations report 'older remote history is not indexed' in the search incomplete list. An edit to an older entry within those 200, such as a replaced or finalized harness entry, can stay unsearchable for up to one hour. Local conversations are indexed as before.

downtime.detail: No migration or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores full remote history indexing.
